Thanks for the call today — lot of good detail on workload shape and our latency/cost targets. Quick follow-up: we'd like to lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML/infra engineers to go through a runbook, integration patterns, and a short capacity sizing exercise.

Priority items for us:
- Clarify KV cache behavior with long-tail sessions
- Deployment options for PHI redaction (VPC/on-prem considerations)
- Typical latency at 2–4 concurrent streams at 8k context

We are fairly compact on attendee count: myself (product), Tom (platform eng), and we'll likely need our security/compliance lead on the thread if we discuss retention/audit. Two tentative windows on our side:
- Tue May 25 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed May 26 — 14:00–15:30 PT

Can you confirm which slot works for Redwood and who from your side should attend? Also helpful to get a short agenda so we can prep.

Thanks,
Sarah
